description: This file contains utility functions and classes for managing endpoints related to keys, users, and teams in a FastAPI-based application. It includes functions for handling budgets, adding members, cache management, and sending alerts.

methods.name: get_new_internal_user_defaults
methods.description: Generates default internal user parameters based on user ID and optional email.

methods.name: handle_budget_for_entity
methods.description: Handles creation or update of budgets for entities like organizations or tags, returning the budget ID.

methods.name: add_new_member
methods.description: Adds a new member to a team, creating or updating user and team membership records, and optionally setting a budget.

methods.name: _delete_user_id_from_cache
methods.description: Removes user ID entries from cache based on provided request data.

methods.name: _delete_api_key_from_cache
methods.description: Removes API key entries from cache based on provided request data.

methods.name: _delete_team_id_from_cache
methods.description: Removes team ID entries from cache based on provided request data.

methods.name: _delete_customer_id_from_cache
methods.description: Removes customer ID entries from cache based on provided request data.

methods.name: send_management_endpoint_alert
methods.description: Sends Slack alerts for management endpoint events such as key, user, or team changes.

methods.name: management_endpoint_wrapper
methods.description: Decorator that wraps management endpoint functions to handle logging, alerting, and cache cleanup.
